sources.personalReadEvidence: BHF L137–148 explicitly links wrist arterial pulse to heart pumping and beat-generated pressure wave: heart alone directly creates the asked pulse. Stomach receives arterial blood(20.5L146,164,168), liver produces bile(23.6L31,52), thyroid may indirectly speed heart(BHFL212–216); receiving blood or altering rate is not direct generation. All choices are real organs with consistent genitive forms. Read direct pressure-wave definition, resting-rate passages, bradycardia variation and complete hyperthyroid/tachycardia context.
